verdict.rationale: Zamzar's API docs describe a distinct sandbox environment at sandbox.zamzar.com, separate from the production endpoint api.zamzar.com. A developer or agent can therefore run test requests in isolation and switch to production only by changing the endpoint. The evidence is a single documentation mention, and the free 'Test' tier adds only light context. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox behavior and limits (whether conversions are real, file and credit constraints), explicit data-isolation guarantees between sandbox and production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: All example requests are made to `https://sandbox.zamzar.com/`. If you want to use the production environment change the endpoint to `https://api.zamzar.com/`.
